name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
candidate:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let C := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  have hb : ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ timeOrderF ∘ₗ mulLinearMap (a * C) =
      LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (ι C) ∘ₗ ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ timeOrderF ∘ₗ mulLinearMap a := by
    apply ofCrAnListFBasis.ext
    intro φs
    simp only [mulLinearMap, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, ofListBasis_eq_ofList,
      LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply,
      LinearMap.mulLeft_apply]
    rw [mul_assoc]
    have ha : ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ timeOrderF ∘ₗ mulLinearMap.flip
        (C * ofCrAnListF φs) =
        LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (ι C) ∘ₗ ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
          timeOrderF ∘ₗ mulLinearMap.flip (ofCrAnListF φs) := by
      apply ofCrAnListFBasis.ext
      intro φs'
      simp only [mulLinearMap, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, ofListBasis_eq_ofList,
        LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply,
        AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, C]
      let s := 𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ)
      let t := (φs' ++ φs).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel
      let l₁ := t.takeWhile fun c => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ c
      let l₂ := φs'.filter fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ
      let l₃ := φs.filter fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ
      let l₄ := t.filter fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ
      let σ := crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs)
      let x := ι (ofCrAnListF l₁) * ι (ofCrAnListF l₂)
      let y := ι (ofCrAnListF l₃) * ι (ofCrAnListF l₄)
      calc
            /- Split the commutator. -/
            _ = σ •
              (ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) -
              s • ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs)))) := by
              conv_lhs =>
                rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
                  superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
                simp [mul_sub, sub_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
                rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
              simp only [map_smul, σ, s, smul_sub, smul_smul]
              rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
              simp only [mul_comm]
            /- Splitting the time-ordered lists. -/
            _ = σ •
              (x * ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) * y - s • x * ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ]) * y) := by
              have h1 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [φ, ψ] φs
                (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
              rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs = φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs by simp, h1]
              have h2 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [ψ, φ] φs
                (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
              rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs = φs' ++ [ψ, φ] ++ φs by simp, h2]
              repeat rw [ofCrAnListF_append]
              simp [x, y, l₁, l₂, l₃, l₄, t, mul_assoc]
            _ = σ •
                (x * ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * y) := by
                rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
                  ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
                simp [s, ← ofCrAnListF_append, mul_sub, sub_mul]
      simp only [x, y]
      rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
      repeat rw [mul_assoc]
      rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
        ← ofCrAnListF_append]
      have h1 := insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' φs
      simp [l₁, l₂, l₃, l₄, t, decide_not, Bool.decide_and, List.append_assoc] at h1 ⊢
      rw [← h1, ← crAnTimeOrderList]
      by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
      · simp [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq]
      · simp only [σ]
        rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ
            (not_ne_iff.mp hq).symm,
          ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp only [map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun ha a
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun hb b
